name: codex-pet-status
description: Sends privacy-filtered Codex lifecycle status to the local Codex Pet bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Mirrors Codex task states to a local ESP32 pet.
interface.longDescription: Observes lifecycle events through Codex hooks and sends only task identifiers and generic state changes to a local bridge. Prompts, commands, output, transcripts, and file paths are discarded.
defaultPrompt: Show me how Codex Pet protects task privacy.
